record_fields.image_path: repository-relative original image path, or null if missing
record_fields.image_sha256: hash from sheet index, or null if missing
record_fields.sheet_path: repository-relative sheet actually inspected, or null
record_fields.geometry_tags: list of permitted tags supported by this image
record_fields.observation: concise visible evidence; distinguish boundary from blocker placement
record_fields.verified_difficulty: unknown unless a cited local source directly labels difficulty
record_fields.verified_strategy: unknown unless a cited local source supports the stated strategy
record_fields.verified_evidence: list of local source references; empty when both verified fields are unknown
record_fields.difficulty_hypothesis: null or object with inference=true, statement, confidence, rationale
record_fields.strategy_hypothesis: null or object with inference=true, statement, confidence, rationale
record_fields.review_note: ambiguities, missing evidence, or original-resolution follow-up

rules: Only mark inspected images reviewed or partial. A prepared sheet or source-derived feature is not inspection.
Use partial when overlays prevent full board interpretation, and needs_review for uncertain observations.
Retain hypotheses as speculative; do not infer measured difficulty, success rate, or optimal strategy.
The eight tags are candidate vocabulary for Royal Match and unchanged v1 vocabulary for Royal Kingdom.
A stepped blocker boundary alone does not justify stair_step, and blockers alone do not prove split_regions.
Record missing levels explicitly and checkpoint every inspected sheet before opening more.
Preserve historical outputs; write new shard JSONL files only.
